products.title: Master The Move: The Ankle Lock by John Danaher
products.body:
In the latest installment of the highly anticipated Master The Move series, John Danaher takes a deep dive into one of the most misunderstood and underutilized submissions in grappling—the ankle lock.

  • The straight ankle lock has submitted world champions, won major championships, and remains one of the most effective lower-body attacks in all of Jiu-Jitsu. Yet despite its success, few athletes truly understand the mechanics, decision-making, and systems that separate average ankle locks from elite-level finishing ability.
  • Widely regarded as the greatest coach and instructional mind in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Danaher breaks down the ankle lock with the same systematic precision that revolutionized back attacks, guard passing, and leg locking.
  • You'll learn the fundamental mechanics behind the classical straight ankle lock, the critical role of hip control, upper body grips, foot positioning, and finishing mechanics. From there, Danaher introduces a comprehensive decision-tree system that teaches you how to react to every common defensive response, ensuring you're always one step ahead of your opponent.



What Will You Learn? 

The straight ankle lock has submitted world champions, won major championships, and remains one of the most effective lower-body attacks in all of Jiu-Jitsu. Yet despite its success, few athletes truly understand the mechanics, decision-making, and systems that separate average ankle locks from elite-level finishing ability.

Now, in the latest installment of the highly anticipated Master The Move series, John Danaher takes a deep dive into one of the most misunderstood and underutilized submissions in grappling—the ankle lock.

Widely regarded as the greatest coach and instructional mind in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Danaher breaks down the ankle lock with the same systematic precision that revolutionized back attacks, guard passing, and leg locking. Rather than teaching isolated techniques, he gives you a complete roadmap for attacking, finishing, troubleshooting, and integrating ankle locks into your overall leg lock game.

You'll learn the fundamental mechanics behind the classical straight ankle lock, the critical role of hip control, upper body grips, foot positioning, and finishing mechanics. From there, Danaher introduces a comprehensive decision-tree system that teaches you how to react to every common defensive response, ensuring you're always one step ahead of your opponent.

This series doesn't stop at basic finishes. Danaher explores advanced applications including belly-down ankle locks, counter-attacking from leg entanglements, cross ankle locks, double trouble scenarios, and the relationship between ankle locks and modern heel hook systems. You'll learn how to enter, attack, and finish from a wide variety of positions while developing a deeper understanding of the strategic concepts that make elite leg lockers so dangerous.

Whether you're a beginner looking to build a reliable submission game or an advanced grappler seeking to sharpen your lower-body attack system, Master The Move: The Ankle Lock delivers the most complete ankle lock blueprint ever released.

  • Learn the complete ankle lock system from legendary coach John Danaher
  • Master the mechanics of the classical straight ankle lock and modern finishing variations
  • Understand the critical concepts of hip control, foot positioning, grip selection, and breaking mechanics
  • Follow Danaher's decision-tree approach to systematically solve common defensive reactions
  • Learn belly-down ankle locks, short ankle locks, cross ankle locks, and one-handed finishing variations
  • Discover how ankle locks integrate with modern Ashi Garami and heel hook systems
  • Develop high-percentage counter attacks against common leg lock positions
  • Study advanced scenarios including Double Trouble, 50/50, leg lace counters, and Z-lock transitions
  • Gain a deeper conceptual understanding of lower-body submissions from the most influential coach in the sport
  • Perfect for both competitors and hobbyists looking to add a complete submission system to their arsenal

products.body:

  • This next installment of his famous "Master the Move Series" does exactly what the title says, allows the viewer to truly develop a world class grasp on the subject matter and in turn, truly MASTER THE MOVE.

products.title: Master The Move Bundle by John Danaher
products.body:
Knowing a technique and truly mastering it are two very different things, and nobody has done more to close that gap than John Danaher.

Danaher is a black belt under Renzo Gracie and the coach behind Gordon Ryan, Garry Tonon and Nicky Ryan. He teaches from first principles: why a technique works, not only how to do it. In the Master The Move series, he applies that approach to one move per course.


This bundle brings together all 13 Master The Move courses released so far, 88 volumes in total. Each course covers a single technique, like the straight arm bar, the anaconda strangle, the side crucifix or the toreando pass, from the entries and grips to the finishing mechanics and what to do when your opponent defends.

Whether you're a white belt building your first reliable attacks or a black belt sharpening moves you already use, every course stands on its own. Start with the technique you want to fix first, or work through the whole set: arm drags to get behind, passes to get past the legs, crucifix positions to control, and submissions to finish.


What Will You Learn?

Danaher doesn't only teach a move for the ideal situation. He goes through the common problems, the defensive reactions you will face and the adjustments that keep each technique working against bigger, stronger and more experienced training partners. That's the difference between knowing a move and hitting it in live rolling.

If you've ever wondered why elite grapplers can hit the same few moves on everyone, this is how they get there: by studying each technique until it holds up under pressure.

Learn how to master the moves that matter, one technique at a time, with John Danaher.

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1: Submissions

  • Master The Move: The Straight Arm Bar Ude Gatame - The Fastest Arm Lock
  • Master The Move: The American Lock
  • Master The Move: The Anaconda Strangle
  • Master The Move: The Ankle Lock
  • Master The Move: Omoplata
  • Master The Move: The Toehold

Part 2: Control Positions

  • Master The Move: The Side Crucifix
  • Master The Move: The Back Crucifix
  • Master The Move: The Shoulder Crunch Series

Part 3: Sweeps and Guard Passing

  • Master The Move: The Butterfly Guard Sweep Sumi Gaeshi
  • Master The Move: The Knee Cut Guard Pass
  • Master the Move: Toreando Guard Pass

Part 4: Takedowns and Entries

  • Master The Move: Arm Drags

products.title: Master The Move: The Toehold by John Danaher
products.body:
The toehold is one of the most versatile leg locks in all of grappling, and few people understand how to use it better than John Danaher.

  • Learn from John Danaher, one of the most respected coaches in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, renowned for his innovative techniques and strategic approach.
  • In Master The Move: The Toehold, Danaher breaks the toehold down over six volumes, from the mechanics of the figure 4 grip to entries from top and bottom, 50/50, the main ashi garami positions and reverse closed guard.
  • This isn't just a submission course, it's a full toehold game that connects with your kneebars and heel hooks.


What Will You Learn?

The toehold is one of the most versatile leg locks in all of grappling, and few people understand how to use it better than John Danaher.

Widely regarded as the greatest coach and instructor in the history of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu, Danaher has built champions at every level of the sport by breaking complex techniques into clear, repeatable systems. Now he's sharing that same approach with the toehold, a submission with unique attributes that separate it from the more conventional leg lock attacks.

In Master The Move: The Toehold, Danaher starts with the main mechanical principles of the figure 4 toehold and the 3 initial problems you will face when you attempt it. Then he shows you his best entries from top position, the spin entry and the back step entry, plus a third option and a way in from bottom position. Volume 2 puts the toehold together with the kneebar: the Double Trouble Kneebar, the kneebar toehold dilemma and the relationship between toeholds and heel hooks. This isn't just a submission course, it's a full toehold game that connects with your kneebars and heel hooks.

Whether you're playing 50/50 or attacking from inside ashi, outside ashi or cross ashi garami, the toehold gives you another way to finish. Danaher covers proactive and reactive 50/50 toeholds, 10 finger toeholds, palm to palm toeholds against standard, outside and cross ashi garami, the outside, inside and clavicle toeholds, and Estima locks from kneeling, standing and sitting.

He also shows you what to do when your opponent fights back. The final volume is built around reverse closed guard: how to enter it, how to get between the knees, how to deal with leg extension, how to roll your opponent through and what to do when he stands up. You learn to follow him through 360 degrees to the finish, and the course closes with the path from reverse closed guard to heel hooks.

If you've ever locked a figure 4 grip on the foot and still couldn't get the tap, this course shows you the mechanics, the entries and the follow ups that turn that grip into a finish.

Learn how to make the toehold one of the most reliable finishes in your leg lock game.

What Exactly Do You Get?

  • The Main Mechanical Principles of the Figure 4 Toehold
